title: The Prophet's Lament and Hope in Micah 7
description: The prophet Micah laments deeply over the moral decay of society: the faithful are gone, violence and bribery prevail, and even family bonds are broken. In the midst of darkness, the prophet turns his gaze to the Lord and waits for his saving God, confident that though he has fallen, he will rise again. The narrative culminates in a praise of God's unique nature: He who forgives sin, does not hold onto His wrath forever, but casts sins into the depths of the sea and shows faithfulness to Jacob and grace to Abraham.
